data.body: Anti-pattern scan: Checked for other occurrences of the cycle-unaware planner-summary-literal-follow pattern. Found 1 confirmed candidate: Phase G Step 2 epic-level HARD-GATE had the identical new_tasks_in_story branch with no implement-vs-marker discipline. Fixed inline (same file, same session). No other sites detected. Observation: the pattern was localized to the two planner-dispatch routing tables (story-level and epic-level) in sprint/SKILL.md.
